actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: ToddlerBot is a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform built for scalable policy learning and research in robotics and AI
The upstream package is fully pip-installable on Python 3.10 or newer
The upstream requires Python 3.10 or newer
The upstream pins mujoco 3.3.4 and mujoco-mjx 3.3.4
The card's primary scene is the MJCF model toddlerbot_2xc_scene and includes the robot model toddlerbot_2xc.xml
The scene sets a statistic center and extent for the camera and adds a floor plane, four trackcom cameras and explicit floor contact pairs for the torso, head, pelvis and limb collision geoms
The robot model compiles in radians with the mesh directory assets and autolimits enabled
The main default class sets the motor ctrlrange to -10 10
The actuator block declares 30 motors, from neck_yaw_drive through right_wrist_roll, one per actuated joint, and none of them overrides the main default class
The torso body carries the free joint torso_freejoint, so the robot base is not actuated
The environment base class is MJXEnv, a brax PipelineEnv subclass
The environment loads its MJCF with brax.io.mjcf and replaces the model's opt.timestep and opt.solver with cfg.sim.timestep and cfg.sim.solver
The card's first entry symbol is CartwheelEnv, registered with env_name cartwheel
The cartwheel environment samples a zero command because the motion reference supplies the motion
The default simulation config sets a 0.005 s time step and the Newton solver

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model and one control sequence deterministically, and the bridge reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData + mj_forward), so a run repeats on the same engine; no seed controls the reset because the scene declares no random state

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the model file for the free joint, the hinge joints, the actuator count, the per-actuator control range and the option time step but integrates placeholder joint motion, so trajectories, contacts, friction, equality constraints, actuator dynamics and the mesh visuals are not MuJoCo's
the stand-in loads no mesh, texture or height field and resolves no contact, equality, tendon or sensor

the upstream MJXEnv training environment (cartwheel_env.py:18) is not exposed: its motion reference, command sampling, observation, reward, domain randomization and episode terms remain upstream, and this package serves the raw cap.world.step.v1/cap.world.reset.v1 contract of the scene

the upstream environment overrides opt.timestep with cfg.sim.timestep (mjx_env.py:487); this package loads the scene file as it is, so the time step is the one the loaded model states, not the gin config
MuJoCo itself and the JAX/MJX stack were not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine and the sim backend was not run
no physical ToddlerBot is modelled by this package and nothing was validated against hardware

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
